title: Carousel configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.CarouselAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/ai-docs/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

Direction.description: Slide direction: ltr, rtl or ttb (vertical). (source type: GlobalEnum.Direction.LTR | GlobalEnum.Direction.RTL | GlobalEnum.Direction.TTB)

Height.description: Height of the carousel (CSS length or pixel number); auto by default, required for the vertical direction. (source type: string | number)

ItemsDesktop.description: Number of items visible at once on desktop.

ItemsGap.description: Gap between items (CSS length or pixel number); 0px by default. (source type: string | number)

ItemsPhone.description: Number of items visible at once on phones.

ItemsTablet.description: Number of items visible at once on tablets.

Loop.description: Rewinds to the first item after the last one.

Navigation.description: Navigation controls to render: Arrows, Dots, Both or None.

Padding.description: Padding on both ends of the track so neighbouring items peek in (CSS length or pixel number). (source type: string | number)

StartingPosition.description: Zero-based index of the item shown first.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
